summary: REQ-8 is largely implemented. A custom hook useIpLocation.ts fetches ipapi.co/json/ using useEffect/fetch, manages all required status messages, and returns location data. Both BookingPage.tsx and BookingFormSection.tsx consume this hook, auto-fill the address field if empty, and display status messages. The diff is truncated so hidden latitude/longitude form fields cannot be fully confirmed, but the location data (latitude, longitude) is returned from the hook and available for use. All other constraints appear respected.

missing_requirements.requirement: Hidden form fields with name='latitude', id='latitude' and name='longitude', id='longitude' must be included in the form submission payload.
missing_requirements.reason: The diff is truncated for both BookingPage.tsx and BookingFormSection.tsx, so the presence of hidden input elements in the rendered form cannot be confirmed. The hook returns latitude/longitude values but actual inclusion of hidden inputs in the form markup is unverifiable from the available diff.
